{{Quote|The Sith no longer posed a threat to the Republic, but the Supreme Chancellor was unsatisfied.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="T12">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War|int=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War}}</ref>}}
'''Pultimo''' was the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a conflict between [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the Republic.

Following the [[Second battle of Korriban|battle of Korriban]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], which saw the defeat of Sadow's Empire, Pultimo ordered a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|Republic counterinvasion]] of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith-controlled space]] aimed at two primary objectives: to ensure the Empire posed no vestigial threat to the Republic and simultaneously free the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] corruption under which it had suffered since the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] in [[6900 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Career===
[[File:Korriban_holocaust.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Pultimo ordered the purge of the Sith Empire's civilization.]]
Pultimo was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who eventually rose to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="SWTORE" /> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]].<ref name="SWTORE" /><ref name="T12" /> After Sadow and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were [[Second battle of Korriban|defeated]] above the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by forces under [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]],<ref name="TotJ: TFotSE 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> who ruled the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] and its [[Empress Teta system/Legends|star system]],<ref name="FtFoCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> Pultimo dispatched [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic forces to invade the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="SWTORE" />

The subsequent [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] served two primary purposes: to ensure that the Empire posed no vestigial threat to the safety of the Republic<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /> by means of a purge of Sith sacred sites<ref name="SWTORE" /> and [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]]<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> and to free the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] corruption under which it had languished<ref name="GH30">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 30: Rise of the Sith Emperor}}</ref> since the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="GH23">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 23: The Sith Order Begins}}</ref> From Pultimo's perspective, the Republic counterinvasion was not directed at the subjugation and slaughter of the Sith citizenry but rather the destruction of the Empire's dark-sided institutions.<ref name="GH30" />

===Legacy===
Pultimo's role in the Great Hyperspace War was later reflected on by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Gnost-Dural]] in a [[holodocumentary]] for the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] led by<ref name="T12" /> Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], a contemporary of Naga Sadow's<ref name="TOR:Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> who constructed his own Sith Empire on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="T11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Although the Sith Empire was defeated in the battle of Korriban, Pultimo was not satisfied with the Republic's victory, believing it was necessary for the Sith civilization and cultural heritage to be eradicated to ensure that they posed no threat to the Republic.<ref name="T12" /> The Chancellor believed the Republic's actions would additionally serve to free the Sith-blooded population of the Empire from the dark side corruption under which it had languished<ref name="GH30" /> since the Empire's formation.<ref name="JvS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pultimo was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which gave some background to the Republic's invasion of the Sith-controlled worlds. The character was mentioned in the [[Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War|twelfth and final entry]] of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', an online video series created to elaborate upon the background for [[BioWare]]'s [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Pultimo was mentioned later in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.
